name: HishabAI
cardLine: Bilingual bookkeeping, inventory, and business reporting in one web application.

meta.stack: Bilingual UI · Bookkeeping workflows · Inventory · AI-assisted data entry

problem: Small business owners often keep sales, expenses, inventory, and customer balances across paper notebooks or disconnected tools. Daily updates become slow, and it is difficult to see a reliable picture of cash, profit, stock, or outstanding balances.
solution: HishabAI brings everyday bookkeeping and business management into one guided web application designed for small businesses.
solutionPoints: Income & expense tracking
Inventory management
Customer and vendor ledgers
Multiple companies under one account
Cash, bank, and mobile financial service tracking
AI voice input
Receipt/memo scanning
Bengali language support
Smart accounting logic behind a simple diary-style interface
challenges: Keep transaction, cash, profit, and stock summaries consistent as records change
Support multiple companies under one account without mixing business data
Make accounting workflows understandable in both English and Bengali
Turn voice and receipt capture into reviewable entries before they affect the ledger
architecture: The product groups data by company and connects transactions to accounts, contacts, inventory, and reporting. Reusable dashboard modules surface cash, income, expense, profit, and stock summaries, while guided forms, voice input, and receipt capture feed a review step before entries are saved.

name: Aid For Men Foundation
tagline: A bilingual nonprofit website with secure content and media management
cardLine: A bilingual nonprofit website with secure content and media management.

meta.stack: Next.js · Tailwind · Bengali UI · Authentication · Admin dashboard · Supabase · Image storage · Blog/content management · User management

problem: The foundation needed one public platform for its mission, campaigns, updates, and media, together with a secure way for authorized staff to maintain that information without editing the codebase.
solution: Developed a responsive Bengali-first platform with authenticated administration for publishing content, managing images, and maintaining user access.
solutionPoints: Responsive public pages for the foundation's mission, work, and updates
Bengali-first interface with reusable content layouts
Secure authentication and role-aware administration
Content, image, and user management from one dashboard
Searchable archive for published material
Production deployment at aidformen.com
challenges: Separate public publishing workflows from protected administration
Design role-aware access for content and user management
Keep image uploads and structured content reliable across devices
Present Bengali content clearly on mobile and desktop
architecture: A Next.js frontend renders public content stored in Supabase. Authentication and role checks protect the admin dashboard; structured content records power public pages and archive search, while managed storage handles uploaded images. Public routes remain separate from editorial and user-management workflows.

name: Relaxe — Performance Ad Creative
cardLine: Performance ad editing, motion graphics, and AI-assisted visual production.

meta.stack: Editing · Motion graphics · Captions · AI-assisted visuals

problem: Explain product benefits while maintaining fast pacing and native-feeling ad creative.
solution: Shaped creator footage into concise performance ads with front-loaded hooks, benefit-led demonstrations, readable captions, and modular visual variations.
solutionPoints: Restructured creator footage around a clear hook and product promise
Built visual demonstrations around the spoken benefits
Added captions and pattern interrupts for sound-off viewing
Created AI-assisted supporting visuals where footage was missing
Optimized pacing and cutaways around the script
challenges: Maintain a native creator feel while keeping the product demonstration clear
Introduce visual variety without distracting from the spoken message
Build reusable sequences that support hook and pacing variations
architecture: Each edit follows a modular direct-response structure: hook, problem, product demonstration, benefits, proof, and call to action. Captions, cutaways, product close-ups, and motion graphics are organized as replaceable layers so new variants can be produced without rebuilding the full edit.
